steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir, it's me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Viscount Harold tasked me with delivering this letter to you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Viscount?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It seems like he really was quite aware of you shadowing him to his barracks on my orders.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The blame is mine for getting found out. Will this affect anything, Sir?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It will not. You may continue.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How did he find you?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Yes, Sir!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: That afternoon...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It is currently five in the afternoon. Now recording today's situation.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Things today are not much different from past recordings.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The infected barracks' soldiers regularly perform drills in the mountains nearby.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Well, I say drills, but it's mostly them trying to stave off boredom.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The uninfected soldiers, on the other hand, have more freedom of movement.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Thanks to this, they get up to all sorts of things. It's a bit of a pain to—Scratch that. Based on previous investigations, most of them simply drink and get rowdy at the taverns at the foot of the mountain.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: There are still four people keeping watch at the camp. Three are playing cards, while one is sleeping.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: After the one who was sleeping woke up, one of the other three left. He seemed to be quite happy as he was walking away.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: If it's to visit the Turiels, I'd say he's taken a fancy to their daughter.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: These Victorians have been here for nearly a month.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Even though I volunteered myself to scout in the first place, the more I watch them the more I wonder if there is even any point in monitoring them.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: They really do look like they're just here for sightseeing.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Ah, right.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It looked like Viscount Harold had returned to camp and started playing cards with the soldiers, but he is now nowhere to be seen...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You know, a kindhearted old man like me would call it a pity that you're out here alone on a mountain, Mr. Weiss.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Which is why I brought along a drink for you.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: No need to worry, old chap.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Watching us every day must be a right chore.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I get it, though. After all, there's a bunch of foreign troops stationed here. I'd be worried too. And so your Sir Enciodes can't help but have a little disdain for us Victorians.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Go on, take a sip already. It'll warm you up.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not great with alcohol.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Is that so? What a pity. I didn't have much taste for booze either, when I was younger. Felt like I could do just about anything sober.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ah, but now I finally understand why drink enchants people so.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Please tell me, Lord Viscount. What exactly will you do, now that you've found me?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I was simply hoping you could assist me in a small matter, Mr. Weiss.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Be a sport and pass this letter along to Enciodes, if you would.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Alright. I'll do that.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Eh? Not going to ask why?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You've already found me out. I couldn't quite hide myself from your keen eyes.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: And pointing it out to me so bluntly speaks volumes about your attitude on the matter.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'll inform my master about that, alongside this letter.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Forgive me, Sir. If only I had trained my scouting a bit more...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There is naught to forgive. No matter what they say, in the end they are still Victorian soldiers.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There is an objective gap between our capabilities and theirs.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It is enough that you perform your work at your own pace.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Moreover, it is as you said. That he wished to use you to convey this to me is telling about his attitude.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You have observed their barracks for nearly a month now.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Tell me what you think of them, Weiss.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Yes, Sir.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Before the Victorian Army even set foot inside Turicum, we had already prepared extensively, just in case.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But we never actually used any of our contingencies.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: They rushed in, as if tomorrow they would occupy all of Kjerag.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But as we braced for impact, we ended up in this situation. They mostly stay at the foot of the mountain, with minimal activity.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: That viscount...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: He deliberately set up camp far from any major towns or cities, so as to minimize disturbances to the locals.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Their barracks are split up into camps for the Infected and uninfected. They've even put up a notice to inform visitors.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: According to some intelligence I dug up, He has even ordered his men to help the locals with their daily tasks.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: How should I put this...?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: He truly respects his men, and he also respects us Kjerags.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: And so I think he's worthy of our respect too.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Otherwise, you wouldn't have asked Matterhorn to pass them medicine and supplies.
Weiss stops speaking, his report complete, but Enciodes does not respond.
The rhythmic sound of Enciodes's index finger slowly tapping at the armrest of his chair clearly echoes throughout the room, like water slowly but firmly dripping from the eaves.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This letter. What do you make of it?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Ultimately, they have infringed on our borders in the name of Victoria. And now, they have used me as the means to pass you this letter.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I believe this was intended as both a rap across the knuckles and a warning.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Could it be... that after all this, they can't actually contain themselves?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You've always been fond of taking the negative tack, Weiss.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Apologies, sir.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No, this is one of your strengths.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You are correct. He deliberately sought you out, so as to reveal his strength.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But at the same time, it is unlikely he would not know that you are my attendant.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A man of his position could approach me directly and to inform me of the contents of this letter.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But he used you to pass it to me instead.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you feel like that is etiquette befitting a noble?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: And... it's a very humble gesture.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: He is a strange man.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He represents the will of a Victorian Duke, but that does not mean—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That every chess piece is a willing puppet.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir, what exactly is the letter regarding?
Enciodes does not reply, merely placing the piece of paper within the envelope atop the table and sliding it towards Weiss.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It's... an invitation?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: An invitation for me, alongside our Saintess, to take part in a dinner party he's arranged.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You and Lady Enya...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Surely he doesn't...? No, it couldn't be. If he really did sense something amiss, he wouldn't go about it in such a friendly manner.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Find Matterhorn, and ask him to take one of the finest bottles from our distillery's storehouse.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ah. On second thought, Weiss.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir...?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No need to go to the distillery. Come with me to the Silverash wine cellar. I will fetch the drink personally.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You mean, the old manor's cellar?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: There may be wine there, but...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You need only do as I ask.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He has already revealed his sincerity to us. And so, it is my turn to do the same.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: What in Kjeragandr's name is going on...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm telling you, we Ursus can drink way more than this any day!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Come visit sometime! It'll be my treat!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hahaha! Very well! It's a deal!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Drink! Come, drink more!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Now that's some fine wine!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Nonono, it's not wine, it's honey!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Man, Kjerag's own local highland honey... *hic* This flavor sure is something else.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's your lucky day, because I brought a few bottles of my own on the train!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Ah, honey! How very sobe... *hic* sobering!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: This flavor is great, stupendous! I, Arctosz, do decree it so! Come, down it!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Eh? Girl, why'd you turn all wrinkly?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hahaha! Buddy, you've got the wrong guy! I'm over here!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Let go... Useless son of mine, let go I say!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hey, kid, how come you're so strong all of a suddenly? Don't tell me you don't like my drinks?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Well that's no good! Wait here, I'll go get the best, bestest spirits!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Just you wait!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, buddy—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I already told you, you got the wrong guy!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You... You two...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Gulo! GULO!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: I'm here, Master!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: What is the meaning of this?!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Sir had drank a bit too much, and once he saw Madam Rosalind, he invited her to drink with him.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: I... I wasn't able to stop them!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Arctosz, you besotted oaf!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: When he looked at Rosalind, did he—did he really not come to any realizations?!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Not exactly.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Well, what then?! Spit it out already!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: When he saw Rosalind, Sir said that she looked a bit familiar.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But I think he might have been too drunk. We waited here a good while, and he didn't say another word about it. Not a peep.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: And then?!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: And then Madam Rosalind thought of something to lighten the mood. She got out some honey drinks she brought with her and gave some to Sir to try...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: And then, well... Here we are.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: How did Arctosz get this far without learning how to handle honey drunkenness?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: It's his nature, I'm afraid. I don't think he could handle it, even if he tried.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: To be honest, he might have inherited it from you, Master...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: (Glare)

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: *cough* *cough*

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: What should we do now?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: What should we do? You're asking me what we should do?

spans.text: What should we do? You're asking

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Wait until Arctosz has sobered up. Once he has a clearer head, even he cannot deny the things that us two have noticed.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: When I see Rosalind, I see Arctosz when he was her age.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: I remember. He didn't have his beard back then.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Pah, he was just afraid of not looking reliable enough. It's a ploy!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: If he had really been reliable back then, it would never had come to this...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Batyushka, you're finally here!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Who wasn't reliable? What back then? What're you guys talking about?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Ah, nothing, just some reminiscing...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hmph, another secret you're keeping.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: All right then, keep your secrets.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Here, batyushka. This is for you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I saved you one last bottle of honey. Let's drink!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: ...Very well.

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (Doesn't sound like there'll be any trouble from them.)

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (Sure looks like a family reunion or something to me.)

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (No, I can't rule out the possibility of them exchanging information via codewords.)

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: (I still need to watch them carefully.)

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You, why are you loafing around over there?

steps.name: Guard?
steps.text: Ah, Master. A new delivery of drink has just arrived, and I need men to help me bring it all in.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You may go, young Gulo.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Yes, Master!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Uh, I'll go on ahead first then?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Yes, just go already. I'll make sure these two don't get up to further trouble.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I brought more drink!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wait, this much?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hahaha! Did you empty the entire cellar or something, my man?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The people of Kjerag are never stingy when treating their guests!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: After gifting me your honey, it's only natural that I share something of mine. I wouldn't want a girl like you thinking I wasn't generous.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Try this one on for size!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Since you have such fine taste, I've grabbed the rarest drink in my collection. I wouldn't even bring it out for the banquet tomorrow!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: 'Snow Realm Spring'? The year's on the label too. Ooh, this looks familiar. I think I've seen this brand in the Doctor's office...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ah, whatever, time to drink up!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah—!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: This stuff is great!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's got a tingle, but it sure goes down easy; refreshing, yet not pungent... Yep, very fine!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hahaha! You sound just like one of those fancy sommeliers!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: At the time, it was awful hard to get this drink.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I had to grease a few palms and hide them behind my father's back to get my hands on this batch.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Why'd you have to keep it a secret?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What, did your dad not let you drink or something?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: No, nothing of the sort. Us men of Kjerag have been drinking since we were in diapers, unlike those Victorians who fall over after a single drop! Hahaha!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Ah, but this... Back then, it was considered taboo, especially for us Paleroches...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But those times are long gone. Things have changed.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Pah! What use is talking about it now?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Come! Have a sip.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Woah!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: This bottle might be even better than the last. If it wasn't for the fact that we were such kindred spirits, I wouldn't give it to you, even if you beat me to death over it!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Gotta sample it nice and slow! Real *hic* slow!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Look, you got it wrong again, boss. I'm over here, that there's a pillar!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Let me give it a try... Hey, why's this sour?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Sour?! How dare you!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: This really is sour... But why?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: It aged well at first, but you have to take into account how it was stored.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Our storage methods back then were not as sophisticated as today, and after so long...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: There would always be a batch or two that went bad.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Went bad...?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'd planned to give this out at the wedding reception and ask that everyone drink their fill.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'd thought... I'd thought I might share a glass of this with her...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You're drunk, Arctosz.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: That's enough for now.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'm not drunk! I'm... I'm not...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: C'mon, give me that bottle!
The girl takes the slightly sour, aged spirit from Arctosz's hand.
She turns up her head, and without the slightest bit of hesitation, raises the bottle and pours the liquid straight down her throat, taking in its varied astringent notes.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah—!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And that's that problem solved. It was a little off, but overall, still a pretty good drink!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: If you want my expert opinion, I'd say you could really grow to love that aftertaste.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Young lady, you—! Have you gone mad?!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Quick, somebody call a doctor—!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Nah, I'm good.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You're good?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It'd long since gone bad, and you still drank it? Haven't you ever heard of food poisoning?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm fine. Really.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I've eaten rotten bread and drank foul water out of the gutter before.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Compared to that, what's this drink gonna do to me?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Out of the gutter...?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Why would you even do such things, girl?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'd rather not talk about those times right now.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But anyway, what I'm trying to say is, I might not really get what the whole deal is here, but I can feel it out.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You said this drink was pretty important, right, boss?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll take that as a yes.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Something as rare as that getting spilled away just because it's gone a little off sure would be sad, don't you think?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Listen...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, c'mon, don't give me that face. It could work for you if you were more handsome, but you'd have to lose the beard first.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey! Why aren't we drinking?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whatever boozy treasures are left, serve 'em up!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Today, the three of us—we're drinking until we drop!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You're sure?

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: I'm sure.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: This might be an issue.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You know, lad, you usually come full of ideas, but you're a right mute here.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Can't blame me for that one, boss.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: When a lord like you suddenly wants to throw a banquet, just freeing up the space for it took our men no small amount of effort.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: It's simply for hosting two foreign dignitaries. Although it's still a bit off for that purpose.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: *sigh* I understand.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: We've invited a chef from a local restaurant to come and cook, and thanks to us and the locals being so buddy-buddy, we've also managed to get some top-quality ingredients to go with.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: We're still stumped on drinks, though.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: These three bottles of 'Snow Realm Spring 1095' were the best we could get from hereabouts.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: This one... Mouthfeel is pleasant enough, and the aroma is suitably complex.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: However, the layering's a little bit weak, and this acridity is somewhat unbalanced.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: It would be fine to offer to someone the same rank as me, but for our guests at this banquet... it's far from appropriate.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: It's only at times like these that your nobility shows, milord.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Well, I do have to work rather hard at it.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Enough already, we all know you're just a boozer who gave yourself the excuse that you're handling the lords and ladies.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Alright, enough lip out of you, go back and help out or something. I'll think over everything else that's left.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Boss, we've been here a whole month, and we've seen that the Kjerags, they really love their Saintess, and this Enciodes guy too.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: I know you keep saying we're just here as tourists.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: What is it you think I'm up to? If I really want to do something, I would tell you to get that ambush sorted before all this.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: That's what you said, sure, but don't expect the boys to come save your hide if something comes up.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Oh, don't be such a worrywart. It's bad luck.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: If I had known sooner, I would have asked the missus to pack that rare red wine we've got in the house.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Whyever are you sighing, My Lord?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ah, Sir Enciodes...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Haha, well, you've caught me in something of a pickle. I'm the one organizing this banquet, but I can't quite find a drink fit for two illustrious guests such as you.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: While worrying over that, I recalled a fine vintage in my collection back home, and it gave me a twinge of homesickness.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm afraid I don't know where exactly you are a viscount of—

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: County Barre.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If I recall correctly, County Barre is not far from Toron.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Indeed! They tend to follow the same trails, have done so for quite a while now.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If that is the case, then you and I were fated to meet, Lord Viscount. I lived in Toron for a time.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: That's right, I feel like we might have met at some banquet or the other, back in the day.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: If only we had recalled this forgotten connection of ours sooner, Sir Enciodes, we wouldn't have had to be at each other's throats.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If I had known that you were such an interesting man, I think we would have made fast friends, My Lord.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I have met with many a noble here in Kjerag, but I believe that you might be the first to get homesick at the thought of some wine.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Would it be remiss for me to assume that My Lord is a family man?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hahahah, if my daughter heard those words, she would most likely die from laughter.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: In her eyes, I'm the most worthless father across all the lands.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Relations always have a different view of things to outsiders.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You're right. Every family has its own issues.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm afraid that I have no solution to your longing for County Barre, but I do have the means to make you feel at home here.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: My Lord, please accept this as a token of my master's regard.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: This is... 'Snow Realm Spring'... '1072'?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I had heard that other than the 'Snow Realm Spring' batch that started distilling in the 90s, there were even rarer bottles from a batch from the 70s.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You're saying this is the real deal?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Kjerag's first distillery was established under my father's auspice, but after his passing in an unfortunate accident, its output too essentially stopped.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I revived it after the founding of Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Thanks to our outdated aging techniques, most of the stuff from the 70s is completely undrinkable these days, but a few bottles from that era still survive.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They were labelled as 1070s, and what few existed were kept in the Silverash clan cellars.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What you see before you is from that collection.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Wow... Just from that hint of fragrance coming from the mouth of that bottle, I can already tell that it'll drive Victoria's greatest sommeliers wild.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: This is a mighty fine drink.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: If I drank any of this, forget about feeling at home, I'd want to stay in Kjerag for another three years.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If that is ever your desire, then of course we will welcome you with open arms.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Not scared of a Victorian soldier, Sir Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If every Victorian soldier is as reasonable a man as you, what have I to fear?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I'm afraid you might have some misunderstandings about me, good sir.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Then it is natural for me to wish to clear up those misunderstandings. Come, let us sit and discuss them.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ah, well... the Saintess hasn't arrived yet, so should we really be sitting?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Great Saintess is quite occupied with various affairs at the moment. There is no need to trouble her over this.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It is as he says. Were I not here, there would be nothing wrong with the two of you sitting down to a chat.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It would have to clear my approval in the end anyhow.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Is that not right, Sir Enciodes?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Great Saintess, I'm honored that you have deigned to grace this banquet with your presence.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It has been quite some time since you first set foot in Kjerag, Lord Viscount.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: In that time, I've heard of the goodwill that you have shown Kjerag, and I had plans myself to reach out to you for our own little chat.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Today is as good an opportunity as any other.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It has been a while, Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Sir Enciodes... You still have not answered my question.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Saintess is correct.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's just that you are the spiritual leader of all Kjerag's people, after all.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Every day, you must hear the hopes and prayers of supplicants, and keep their faith in Kjeragandr in their hearts.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Nowadays all the nations of Terra have heard tell of Her, and one by one they set their eyes on Her. This too, is yet another matter that occupies your attention.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There is no need for you to personally attend to the mundane matters of the nation.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You tell a good joke, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The reason why Kjeragandr attracts more and more attention from the outside world is in fact because we take note of our people's hopes and prayers, and that we work towards a better life for all of them.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And that being the case, it means that there is no such thing as a mundane matter of the nation.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It need only be a matter of concern to the people to be a matter of concern to me.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I am sure that you would understand this simple reasoning of mine, right, Sir Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I understand this point. As a good friend of mine once counselled me, whether in family matters or matters of state, if you try to grasp everything at play, it will often times not go as you planned.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And as a good friend once counselled me, whether in family matters or matters of state, even if you cannot attend to everything personally, you must see things through your own eyes and do things with your own hands at least once.

spans.text: And as a good friend once counselled
, whether in family matters or matters of state, even if you cannot attend to everything personally, you must see things through your own eyes and do things with your own hands at least once.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Do you hold family matters in your heart, Sir Enciodes, or matters of state?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What is it that you wish to see, Great Saintess? What is it that you wish to do?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ah, Great Saintess, just before you arrived, Sir Enciodes gifted me a bottle of liquor.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: 'Snow Realm Spring 1072'.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: A drink so fine, its only flaw is that it will upstage the main dish.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It is my gift to you. Are you afraid that it might steal your thunder as our host?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hardly, hardly.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: While I am the host, I can't really call myself the lord of this place, can I?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I would say that the Saintess herself would be considered the star of the evening.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It seems I have overstepped my bounds.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: If I may, Saintess, I have a proposal.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I think we should use this bottle of 1072 as the drink for tonight's meal.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What say you, Sir Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...In 1072, when our father placed these bottles into our cellar, he believed that Kjerag's spring was just around the corner.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But even after waiting for more than twenty years, our spring has still not yet truly arrived.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Now, if this bottle were a signal for the opportunity before us, that would truly be a wonderful thing.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Eloquent as ever, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Now that matter's settled, Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Yes, Saintess?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Take this bottle to the kitchen, if you would.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: At once, Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Is that to your satisfaction, My Lord?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Well, since our two guests of honor have arrived... Let's get this banquet started.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Please, have a seat.
